tools.name: scan_website
tools.description: Run a SimplyScan Security Engine security & speed scan (Pro with an entitled API key; otherwise free) of a deployed web app URL. Returns a 0-100 score and findings (exposed secrets, missing Supabase RLS, frontend leaks, speed issues). Best for apps built with Lovable, Bolt, v0, Cursor, Replit, etc.

tools.name: scan_local_code
tools.description: Send selected editor file contents to the SimplyScan Security Engine's deterministic repository rules. Requires a Pro API key. Source leaves the editor, is processed in memory, and is not retained; masked findings are saved in the private scan record. No AI provider receives these files. Code rules

tools.name: check_security_headers
tools.description: Grade a URL's HTTP security headers (CSP, HSTS, X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, COOP, COEP) A-F.

tools.name: check_ai_visibility
tools.description: AEO check: whether AI answer engines (ChatGPT/GPTBot, Claude, Perplexity, Google-Extended, etc.) can crawl and cite the site, plus llms.txt and structured-data signals.

tools.name: check_seo
tools.description: On-page SEO audit of a URL: title, meta description, H1, canonical, indexability, Open Graph, structured data, image alt coverage, sitemap. Returns an A-F grade.

tools.name: check_ssl
tools.description: Inspect a domain's SSL/TLS certificate: issuer, expiry, protocol, and flags for expiring/self-signed/mismatched certs.

tools.name: check_email_security
tools.description: Check a domain's email authentication: SPF, DKIM (common selectors), and DMARC policy. Flags spoofable domains.

tools.name: check_exposed_files
tools.description: Probe a site for accidentally exposed high-risk files (.env, .git/config, backups, etc.). Reports HTTP status only, never file contents.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_security_headers, check_seo, check_email_security · Private data: scan_website, scan_local_code, check_exposed_files · Public sink: scan_local_code, check_email_security · Destructive: scan_website.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_security_headers, check_seo, check_email_security · Private data: scan_website, scan_local_code, check_exposed_files · Public sink: scan_local_code, check_email_security · Destructive: scan_website

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "scan_website" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
